text:
reena: Quick note — /v1/generate examples are inconsistent: OpenAPI shows `input: \"...\"` but SDK examples use `messages`. New chat models prefer messages; users hit validation errors. Can we standardize?

sam: Yep. Runtime accepts both for now, but docs should lead with `messages` for chat endpoints and keep a tiny legacy example for `input`. Add a one-line migration snippet.

kai: Taking this. I'll update the OpenAPI example, JS/py/curl snippets, and examples repo. Plan: recommended chat example first, then a short \"legacy -> migrate\" mapping. I'll open a PR and add a test for the example runner.

lena: Also spotted a schema issue: `choices` documented as an object in one spot; actual responses use an array. Change schema to `choices: [ { index, text?, delta? } ]` and include non-streaming and streaming samples.

sam: Good catch. Include a small streaming snippet showing `choices[].delta` fragments. Note that final chunk may include `text`.

kai: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4472 — updates examples and response schema. CI should run once pushed.

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #4472 ✅ preview: https://deploy-preview-4472--docs.redwood.ai/api-reference/generate

reena: Thanks — once merged I'll add a blurb to the migration guide and release notes. :thumbsup:
